source_text: WARNING: Never reach into the conveyor while the drive motor is energised.
WARNING: Each worker must apply a personal lock to the isolation point.
CAUTION: Stored energy in the belt tensioner can cause sudden movement.
DANGER: Do not bypass the emergency stop circuit for any reason.
Notify all affected operators that the conveyor will be shut down for maintenance.
Stop the conveyor using the normal stop button at the control panel.
Switch off the main isolator and confirm the isolator handle is in the off position.
Apply your personal lock and danger tag to the main isolator.
Release stored energy by slackening the belt tensioner screw.
Press the start button to verify that the conveyor does not move.
Carry out the maintenance task described in the work order.
Remove locks and tags only after all personnel are clear of the conveyor.

WARNING: Wear chemical splash goggles and a face shield during transfer.
WARNING: Never add water to the concentrated acid.
CAUTION: Keep the emergency eyewash station clear and within 10 metres.
DANGER: Do not transfer acid without secondary containment in place.
Check the drum label against the transfer request form.
Position the drum on the spill containment pallet.
Connect the grounding clamp to the drum and the receiving container.
Insert the drum pump and tighten the bung adapter by hand.
Pump the acid slowly into the receiving container up to the fill line.
Flush the pump with 5 litres of clean water into the neutralisation tank.
Record the transferred volume in the chemical inventory log.
Inspect the area for drips and report any spill to the supervisor.

WARNING: Never open the lid while the rotor is spinning.
WARNING: Balance opposing tubes to within 0.1 grams before every run.
CAUTION: Wear a lab coat and safety glasses when loading biological samples.
DANGER: Do not exceed the maximum rotor speed printed on the rotor label.
Inspect the rotor and buckets for cracks or corrosion.
Load the tubes into opposite buckets so the rotor is balanced.
Close the lid and confirm the lid lock indicator is lit.
Set the speed to 3000 rpm and the run time to 10 minutes.
Start the run and remain nearby until the rotor reaches full speed.
Wait for the rotor to stop completely and the lid lock to release.
Remove the tubes and wipe the buckets with disinfectant.
Record the run details in the centrifuge logbook.

WARNING: Never operate a forklift that has failed any inspection item.
WARNING: Keep hands clear of the mast and chains while testing the lift.
CAUTION: Battery electrolyte is corrosive; wear gloves when checking the battery.
DANGER: Do not inspect the forklift with the forks raised above the ground.
Park the forklift on level ground and lower the forks fully.
Engage the parking brake and switch off the ignition.
Walk around the truck and check the tyres for cuts and wear.
Check the hydraulic hoses and cylinders for oil leaks.
Test the horn, lights and reversing alarm.
Check the battery charge indicator and the electrolyte level.
Test the service brake and steering at low speed.
Record the inspection result on the daily checklist and sign it.
